It is known to support heart health by reducing cholesterol levels and improving blood circulation, which can lower the risk of cardiovascular diseases. The plant also contains antioxidants that help combat oxidative stress, potentially reducing the risk of chronic diseases like cancer and diabetes. Additionally, its leaves and seeds are used in traditional medicine to enhance digestion, boost immunity, and promote mental clarity, making it a valuable addition to daily wellness routines.
